item.title: Qatar and the US hold their eighth Strategic Dialogue in Washington
item.description:
Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al-Thani and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio chaired the eighth Qatar-US Strategic Dialogue in Washington on Monday. The two sides signed an artificial intelligence acceleration partnership and a memorandum of understanding on critical minerals processing. The joint statement cited a $38 billion defence Statement of Intent and a $30 million Qatari pledge to the UN trust fund for the Gang Suppression Force in Haiti.
Sources: Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738905/qatar/prime-minister-and-minister-of-foreign-affairs-us-secretary-of-state-chair-8th-qatar-us-strategic-dialogue · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/joint-statement-on-the-eighth-qatar-united-states-strategic-dialogue-an-enduring-strategic-partnership · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B2-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%83%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83%D8%A7

item.title: Al Ansari says Qatar will not accept any attack on its territory
item.description:
Foreign Ministry spokesperson Dr Majed bin Mohammed Al Ansari said at the weekly briefing on Tuesday that Qatar will not accept any attack on its territory, whatever its form. The remarks followed Tehran’s summoning of Qatar’s chargé d’affaires in protest at the Qatar-Germany statement that condemned Iranian attacks on Qatar and other countries in the region. Al Ansari said the summoning was being handled through diplomatic channels.
Sources: Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/qatar-says-it-will-not-accept-attacks-after-iran-protests-over-joint-statement-with-german · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/qatar-continues-mediation-efforts-on-hormuz-calls-for-pressure-on-israel-to-implement-gaza-peace-plan

item.title: Qatar presses mediation to restore freedom of navigation in Hormuz
item.description:
The Foreign Ministry spokesperson said on Tuesday that Qatar is working to restore freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and to help reach a US-Iran agreement, warning that any military escalation could undermine those efforts. In Washington, the Prime Minister had said the region cannot bear a new escalation between the United States and Iran. On Gaza, Al Ansari called for pressure on Israel to meet its commitments under the peace plan.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/qatar-continues-mediation-efforts-on-hormuz-calls-for-pressure-on-israel-to-implement-gaza-peace-plan · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/iran-orders-hormuz-closed-further-day-by-day-as-qatar-seeks-to-revive-peace-talks · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B2-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%83%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83%D8%A7

item.title: Al Shamal come from behind to beat Al Ahli Saudi 3-2
item.description:
Al Shamal beat defending champions Al Ahli Saudi 3-2 on Monday evening at Al Bayt Stadium in round five of the AFC Champions League Elite. Al Ahli led through Feras Al-Brikan and Ivan Toney before Baghdad Bounedjah and Tiago Silva levelled and Alex Collado scored the winner a minute into stoppage time. Al Shamal moved to eight points in seventh place.

item.title: Al Sadd face Al Nassr in Riyadh needing a result to stay alive
item.description:
Al Sadd play Al Nassr at King Saud University Stadium in Riyadh in round five of the West Region league stage of the AFC Champions League Elite. Al Sadd are 13th with two points, against six for Al Nassr in 10th. Coach Razvan Lucescu said the team is seeking a positive result and that the match would not be decisive in the race for the round of 16.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/al-sadd-seek-lifeline-against-al-nassr · Qatar Living (QNA) https://www.qatarliving.com/en/article/lucescu-seeks-positive-al-sadd-result-against-al-nassr

item.title: Qatar Airways launches Amazing Friday offers with up to 25% off
item.description:
Qatar Airways launched its Amazing Friday promotion in Qatar with savings of up to 25% on flights to more than 170 destinations. Bookings run from 23 to 30 November for travel until 30 October 2027, with one free date change. The airline also announced it will resume flights to Malta on 22 March 2027 with three weekly services.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/qatar-airways-launches-amazing-friday-offers-with-savings-of-up-to-25 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D9%84%D9%82-%D8%AE%D8%B5%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D9%84-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-25

item.title: Coalition says tower in Riyadh financial centre was attacked
item.description:
Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki said on Tuesday that one of the towers at the Riyadh Financial Centre was targeted in a terrorist attack and that the relevant authorities were on site. AFP, citing witnesses, said Riyadh’s tallest skyscraper, which houses the Public Investment Fund, was hit. Reuters said it was the second attack on the district in less than a week.
Sources: Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/saudi-arabia/tower-in-saudi-arabias-financial-district-targeted-in-terrorist-attack-coalition-says-3013857 · TASS (AFP) https://tass.com/world/2224083 · News.az (Reuters) https://news.az/news/saudi-led-coalition-says-tower-in-riyadhs-financial-district-targeted-in-terrorist-attack

item.title: IRGC says three tankers struck mines in Hormuz
item.description:
The IRGC Navy said three oil tankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire. The Joint Maritime Information Centre said the claims were unconfirmed and kept the threat level in the strait at “severe”. Hormuz traffic is 65% below pre-war levels, at about 28 US-facilitated transits a day.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/mid-east-war-what-irgc-claimed-what-jmic-reported-what-residents-need-to-know-today-nov-24-2026-1.500758721 · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/iran-orders-hormuz-closed-further-day-by-day-as-qatar-seeks-to-revive-peace-talks · Siasat (AP) https://www.siasat.com/iran-insists-no-talks-with-us-until-7-conditions-are-met-3585572/

item.title: Ghalibaf rules out talks with Washington until Iran’s seven conditions are met
item.description:
Parliament speaker and chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said on Tuesday that Tehran will not negotiate with the United States until its seven conditions are met, according to state television. State media say the conditions include lifting sanctions, ending the naval blockade and releasing frozen assets. Army chief Maj. Gen. Amir Hatami had ordered the navy to tighten the closure of the strait “further day by day” until the conditions are met.
Sources: Siasat (AP) https://www.siasat.com/iran-insists-no-talks-with-us-until-7-conditions-are-met-3585572/ · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/24/iran-orders-hormuz-closed-further-day-by-day-as-qatar-seeks-to-revive-peace-talks

item.title: Brent falls to $88.28, near a three-month low
item.description:
Brent fell 1.22% to $88.28 a barrel on Tuesday and US crude slipped to $79.18, after Brent touched its lowest level since 27 August during the session. The decline followed a 3.46% drop on Monday as Middle East exports recovered and Libya’s Sharara pipeline resumed flows. Goldman Sachs raised its December Brent forecast from $90 to $105.

item.title: Etihad keeps Riyadh and Dammam flights suspended until 30 November
item.description:
Etihad Airways extended cancellations between Abu Dhabi and Riyadh and Dammam until 30 November, while flydubai extended its Riyadh and Abha cancellations until 27 November. The moves come as Houthi attacks on Saudi cities continue and the Hormuz threat level stays “severe”.

item.title: Egyptian bourse closes higher, adding EGP13.7bn
item.description:
The Egyptian Exchange closed Tuesday’s session broadly higher, with the benchmark EGX30 ending at 50,885.33 points, up 0.34%. Market capitalisation rose by about EGP13.7 billion to EGP4.010 trillion on turnover of EGP8.4 billion. Egyptians and Arabs were net buyers of EGP136.1 million and EGP34.1 million, while foreigners were net sellers of EGP170.2 million.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2535112 · Amwal Al Ghad https://amwalalghad.com/2026/11/24/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%B5%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%BA%D9%84%D9%82-%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AB%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B9%D9%84-6/ · Youlyou https://www.youlyou.com/101961

item.title: 21-carat gold slips to EGP5,675 at the close
item.description:
The price of 21-carat gold in Egypt fell on Tuesday to EGP5,675 a gram (selling) at the close, from EGP5,700 in the morning, while the gold pound stood at EGP45,400. The decline came even as the ounce recovered globally to about $3,629, with markets awaiting US inflation data due on Wednesday.
Sources: Aswaq Information https://www.aswaqinformation.com/259992 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534939 · Cairo Mubasher https://www.cairomubasher.com/255513

item.title: Madbouly says major Sovereign Fund deals are coming
item.description:
Prime Minister Dr Mostafa Madbouly reviewed on Tuesday the implementation of the Sovereign Fund of Egypt’s projects, with Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade Mohamed Farid Saleh. Cabinet spokesman Mohamed Adel said several important deals would be announced in the coming period as part of expanding partnership with the local and foreign private sector.

item.title: Government stresses a secure strategic stock of petroleum products
item.description:
The Prime Minister met Finance Minister Ahmed Kouchouk and Petroleum and Mineral Resources Minister Karim Badawi in the New Capital on Tuesday and stressed the need for a secure strategic stock of petroleum products and the required funding. Kouchouk said the ministry is working to settle financial arrears with the petroleum sector, and Badawi said paying foreign partners’ dues strengthens the confidence of global companies.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534991 · Al Ouroba https://www.alouroba.com/69770

item.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and its shares jump 31%
item.description:
Nvidia’s board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director with immediate effect, 11 days after he resigned. The shares soared more than 31% on Monday, adding over $950 billion in market value. A committee of independent directors is continuing its investigation into reports that Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort, and the board has set up a National Security and Export Control Committee.
Sources: NVIDIA (SEC filing) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000090/nov23pressrelease.htm · Gulf Times (Reuters) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738919/business/huangs-nvidia-return-sparks-relief-for-battered-ai-trade-but-questions-remain · The Neuron https://www.theneuron.ai/digest/everything-that-happened-in-ai-today-november-24-2026/

item.title: Nasdaq jumps 6.51% in its biggest gain since April 2025
item.description:
The S&P 500 closed on Monday at 7,237.17, up 4.73%, the Nasdaq at 24,089.56, up 6.51%, and the Dow at 49,595.31, up 3.01%, the strongest daily gains since April 2025. The VIX volatility index fell to 27.05. In Tuesday premarket trading, S&P 500 futures were down about 1%.
Sources: Journal Arta https://journalarta.com/en/2026/11/24/stock-market-today-sp-500-closes-4-73-higher-nasdaq-jumps-6-51-as-vix-plunges/ · Coinpaper https://coinpaper.com/39344/s-and-p-500-and-nasdaq-live-us-stocks-drop-after-monday-s-4-7-and-6-5-rally · Yahoo Finance (Zacks) https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/stock-market-news-nov-24-080800306.html

item.title: European Commission proposes 22nd package of sanctions on Russia
item.description:
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed in Strasbourg a 22nd package of sanctions on Russia. It would cut about 60 Russian banks off SWIFT, list more than 70 additional shadow-fleet vessels, ban tankers insured in Russia and bar Russian ex-combatants from entering the EU. The package needs the unanimous approval of all 27 member states.
Sources: The News International https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/1424899-eu-proposes-22nd-russia-sanctions-package-targeting-60-banks-crypto-and-sports · China.org.cn (Xinhua) https://www.china.org.cn/2026-11/24/content_118787033.shtml · Yahoo News (IntelliNews) https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/eu-proposes-22nd-russia-sanctions-115112094.html

item.title: Supply surplus pushes oil to a three-month low
item.description:
Brent futures fell $3.20 to settle at $89.37 on Monday as Libya’s Sharara pipeline resumed flows to Zawiya and Middle East exports recovered. Deutsche Bank said global liquid hydrocarbon inventories rose by 52 million barrels in October, implying a surplus of 1.7 million barrels a day.
Sources: Bioplastics News https://bioplasticsnews.com/2026/11/24/oil-prices-three-month-lows-global-supply-recovers/ · UNN (Reuters) https://unn.ua/en/news/oil-prices-approached-three-month-lows · CaixaBank Research https://www.caixabankresearch.com/en/publications/financial-markets-daily-report/24-november-2026

item.title: IG Metall strikes continue at German car plants
item.description:
IG Metall called more than 23,000 workers at 19 sites in northern Germany out on 24-hour strikes at Mercedes and BMW plants on Tuesday, part of a wave of strikes that began last week. The union is demanding a 5% pay rise and job guarantees, while employers are offering a one-off payment and a 1.3% rise in 2028. About 3.7 million people work under the sector’s collective agreement.
